summary: This note covers the release and box office performance of Ocean's 8. The film premiered at Alice Tully Hall in New York City on June 5, 2018, and Warner Bros. released it to North American theaters on June 8. It earned $296.9 million worldwide against a $70 million production budget.
one_line: Ocean's 8 premiered in New York in June 2018 and grossed $296.9 million worldwide against a $70 million budget.
key_facts: Ocean's 8 premiered at Alice Tully Hall in New York City on June 5, 2018.
Warner Bros. released Ocean's 8 to theaters in North America on June 8, 2018.
Ocean's 8 grossed $139.4 million in the United States and Canada.
Ocean's 8 grossed $157.5 million in other territories.
Ocean's 8 had a total worldwide gross of $296.9 million.
Ocean's 8 had a production budget of $70 million.
